Title: General availability of IaaS migration from classic to Resource Manager

Body.Content: Today we're announcing the general availability of platform-managed IaaS migration of resources from the classic deployment model to the Azure Resource Manager deployment model. All migration functionality that was released as a preview on May 12 is now generally available. Storage account migration from classic to Resource Manager is also generally available.
